evidence.note: Under a fixed sampling-compute budget, synthetic reasoning data generated by sampling many solutions from a smaller, weaker model trains better reasoners than fewer solutions from a larger, stronger one.
evidence.title: Smaller, Weaker, Yet Better: Training LLM Reasoners via Compute-Optimal Sampling

evidence.note: QUTE is an early-exit-assisted ensemble architecture that quantifies predictive uncertainty in KB-sized TinyML classifiers within a single forward pass, for on-device monitoring without labels.
evidence.title: QUTE: Quantifying Uncertainty in TinyML models with Early-exit-assisted ensembles for model-monitoring
